title: Registration closes in one hour
scenario: A message says your team was nominated for a regional competition, but registration closes in one hour. The form asks for your full name, date of birth, home address and a parent’s card for a “refundable entry hold.”

answers.A: Verify the competition through the school/coach or the organizer’s official website before entering personal or payment details.
answers.B: Ask a parent or coach to review the registration independently.
answers.C: Fill in the personal details now and wait on the payment field until someone confirms it.

explanation: Urgency can turn an exciting opportunity into an identity-data grab. Verify the event before feeding the form.
